name: project_hero
title: Project Hero
description: Top of a project page: optional logo badge, eyebrow (type + date), the title as h1 (last word in the post color), the SEO description, two buttons, meta (website: Platform / Scope / Status) or stats (media: photos / videos / galleries), and a stage: "website" = the cover screenshots in a browser frame + phone, "media" = a gallery image in a window, a square frame and a video card that plays in the popup. Without screenshots or media the stage shows the thumbnail. Background: grid lines + a glow in the post color.
